idea-plugin.name: Homebody
idea-plugin.description: Homebody keeps your AI agents from sending anything anywhere you have not agreed to. This plugin brings the parts you need while working into the editor: a status indicator, Homebody's questions, an agent opened protected on a copy of your project, and a way to block everything at once. It talks only to the Homebody app running on this computer.

action.text: Open an Agent Protected, on This Project
action.description: The agent works on a copy of this project and cannot touch anything else of yours.
See the agent's changes and put them into your project.
What your agents reached, and what was stopped.
Stops every protected app from sending anything, at once.
